title: Object outside the layout
description: Layout-quality rule — a top-level object sticks out beyond the layout boundaries: past the layout width, below the last part, or into negative coordinates. Only top-level objects are checked because those are positioned in absolute layout coordinates; nested objects are relative to their container and are covered by the lost-object rule. Small overshoots are often rounding artefacts — the tolerance slider suppresses them.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Objects beyond the layout boundary are invisible in Browse mode but still evaluate hide conditions, join the tab order and can widen the printed page.
rule.remediation: Move the object back into the layout area, or delete it if it is a leftover.
